concepts.gloss_en: Verse Ps. 29:2 "Bow down to the Lord in the splendor of holiness," cited as proof-text (acronym for קבלה / aspect of yichuda ila'ah)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical verse quotation Ps. 29:2 in the same paragraph (lm1:11), differing only by the apostrophe after לה — a punctuation/orthographic variant, not a different word. They point to the same phrase (linked to both קבלה acronym and yichuda ila'ah, which are two relations of the same verse). Safe merge.
